verdict.rationale: Docs confirm webhooks fire for all subscription lifecycle events (renewal, cancellation, non-payment) and specifically cite subscription_cancelled as an example event type, with idempotency-key support for reliable delivery; community evidence corroborates real-world use of multiple webhook endpoints across environments. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a full canonical event-type list (renewal/upgrade/payment-failure named individually) and independent evidence of delivery guarantees/retry behavior for webhook failures.
